_comment: GENERIC personal/job-application context markers for the T2 leak gate. These are CATEGORY words only — never the operator's real name, employers, or CV content (which must not live in the repo). A card/trace/row that hits any of these is treated as personal context and excluded from training. Augmented at build time by any sids in <PRIME_SILO_HOME>/longview/quarantine.json (not committed).
